findings.checklist_item: - [ ] Specify a log/metric emitted by replay_transition on attempt, success, and abort (including the failing hop and exception type) so the new multi-hop path is observable.
evidence: Plan says replay 'aborts if ANY hop raises the UNION...' and 'falls through to the EXISTING comment-fallback + drift arm' but names no log/metric/trace at the replay boundary
New failure point (per-hop transition_issue_by_name loop) with no instrumentation described
findings.finding: The plan adds a new multi-hop transition-replay failure point but does not mention any logging/metric when replay is attempted, succeeds, or aborts to drift. Operators cannot observe that a replay occurred or why it fell through to comment-fallback.
scenarios: A replay silently aborts mid-chain and the ticket drifts; an operator debugging the drift has no signal that replay was even attempted or which hop failed
findings.suggested_fix: Add a debug/info log in replay_transition recording remote_id, the remaining hop list, and on abort the failing target + exception; note it in Approach 4.

findings.checklist_item: - [ ] State explicitly that a mid-chain abort leaves already-executed hops committed (partial advance) and that the subsequent drift/reconcile resumes safely from the new current status via the resume-anchoring in Approach 2.
evidence: 'Replay calls it once per remaining Jira-name hop, in order' + 'On abort it falls through to the EXISTING comment-fallback + drift arm' — a mid-chain abort leaves executed hops committed
findings.finding: Replay can leave Jira in a PARTIAL intermediate state: if an early hop succeeds and a later hop raises, the issue advances (e.g. to 'In Progress') then falls to comment-fallback+drift. The plan states 'No partial hop is retried' but does not explicitly acknowledge that the issue is left mid-chain (not at its original state) when it drifts.
scenarios: Recorded hops To Do->In Progress->Done; In Progress hop succeeds, Done hop raises IllegalTransitionError; ticket now sits at In Progress with result=None (drift), differing from both original and target

findings.checklist_item: - [ ] Specify that the widened except in step 4 re-raises RetryExhaustedError (a RuntimeError subclass that is NOT a transition rejection) ahead of the transition-rejection union, so transient exhaustion propagates rather than routing into replay/drift.
evidence: Plan: 'Replay aborts if ANY hop raises the UNION ... RuntimeError (acli, acli.py:536)'
RetryExhaustedError is imported alongside RuntimeError-family errors; a 5xx/429/timeout exhaustion is not a workflow rejection
ABSENCE: the plan's union does not distinguish transient exhaustion from a transition rejection
findings.finding: The step-4 exception union catches RuntimeError as a transition-rejection shape, but RetryExhaustedError is a RuntimeError subclass; a genuinely transient exhausted-retry failure would be misrouted into replay/comment-fallback/drift instead of propagating to the pass's soft-fail backstop.
findings.location: Approach step 4 (Failure mode) / dispatch_one.py failure arm
scenarios: An intermittent 5xx during update_issue exhausts retries and raises a RuntimeError-subclass, which the widened catch swallows into replay/drift
findings.suggested_fix: Add to step 4: catch and re-raise RetryExhaustedError before the RuntimeError/ValueError/HTTPError/JiraAPIError union so a transient exhausted retry propagates to the soft-fail backstop instead of being treated as a hop rejection.

findings.checklist_item: - [ ] Specify that replay_transition returns False (falls through to comment-fallback + drift) when the resume point leaves zero remaining hops, so no transition means no false 'landed' result.
evidence: Plan: 'anchor on the LAST (highest index ...) and replay the hops AFTER it'
ABSENCE: no rule for the empty-remaining-hops case
AC list has test_replay_resume_point_matches... but none covers a zero-remaining-hops resume
findings.finding: Step 2 says to anchor on the LAST positional match and 'replay the hops AFTER it', but does not define replay_transition's return when the current status IS the last recorded hop (zero remaining hops). Returning True would report 'landed' without performing any transition.
scenarios: Current status equals the trail's final recorded hop, so hops-after-it is empty and no transition runs
findings.suggested_fix: State in step 2/step 4 that an empty remaining-hop list after the resume anchor aborts replay (returns False) to drift, since zero transitions cannot land the target.

findings.checklist_item: - [ ] Specify that replay_transition aborts to drift (returns False) unless the recorded trail's final forward-mapped hop equals target_status, so a walk is only reported as 'landed' when it actually reaches the requested end state.
evidence: Plan step 3: 'Replay calls it once per remaining Jira-name hop, in order'
Plan step 5: 'only if it returns False does the current comment-fallback run'
ABSENCE: no guard that hops[-1] == target_status
findings.finding: The mechanism never verifies that the recorded trail's final Jira-name hop equals target_status before replaying. If the trail ends at a different status, replaying the remaining hops lands off-target yet the plan treats a successful walk as 'the update lands'.
findings.location: Approach steps 2-3 (resume + replay), step 5 wiring (result set on True)
scenarios: Recorded trail is open->in_progress but target_status for this mutation is Done; replaying to In Progress succeeds and is reported as landed though the ticket never reached Done
findings.suggested_fix: Add a precondition in step 2/3: if the last element of the forward-mapped hop list != target_status, abort to drift; only replay when the recorded trail terminates at the requested target.
